When you play online, always follow these notes. If you are under 18, be sure to have a grown-up at home (your parent or guardian, or the KDDI "Multi Matching BB Service" member) read these notes and the "Capcom Online Game Terms of Use".
This mode costs a set amount each month from the day you start until you cancel, however much or little you play (the amount is in the manual).
A grown-up at home pays, so always ask them first (the bill goes to them).
If the network or your line has trouble, matches may not work or may stop partway, but the monthly money is still charged.

What others say in chat isn't always right.
Check for yourself before you believe it.
If someone says nasty things in chat, don't answer; ignore them. If they keep at it, talk to a grown-up at home.
In chat, don't say things you wouldn't like said to you, or that upset others.
In chat, never tell others your name, address, phone number or anything about you, your family or friends.
Don't stop a match on purpose during an online game. It spoils it for the other players.
If you keep bothering others, we may stop you from playing online.
